ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c,"Draft")), OR( ISBLANK(First_Name__c), ISBLANK(Last_Name__c), ISBLANK(Date_of_Birth__c), ISBLANK(Mobile__c), ISBLANK(Address_Line1__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: First Name, Last Name, Date of Birth, Mobile and Address Line 1 are required before submitting.
